h1.en: Diesel 50 Concrete Pump is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Metre

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. Main-unit weight is is 3300 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metre.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油50型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。理论输送量是30 m³/h，最大出口压力是30 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metre。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metre. Subject: Metric standards Rijksmuseum. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. The frame “Loader (equipment)” shows UNIMOG with front loader and excavator attachment (backhoe loader) and is not a site measurement of this model. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metre。画面主体：Metric standards Rijksmuseum。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油50型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 3300 kg. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. Subject: UNIMOG with front loader and excavator attachment (backhoe loader). Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³.
body.zh: 理论输送量是30 m³/h，最大出口压力是30 MPa。主体：UNIMOG with front 装载机 and 挖掘机 attachment (反铲 装载机)。

heading.zh: 米的国际单位制词头形式

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Main-unit weight is is 3300 kg. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140.
body.zh: 画面「Loader (equipment)」的主体是UNIMOG with front 装载机 and 挖掘机 attachment (反铲 装载机)，不是这个型号的工地实测。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

heading.zh: 用其他单位表示的等价值

body.en: Theoretical Output is 30 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. The shown output stays 30 m³/h. Main-unit weight is 3300 kg.

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metre.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metre画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 30 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metre.
